relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP upregulated the expression of inducible nitric oxide synthase through the p38 signaling pathway in cultured SGCs

relationships.subject: L-arginine
relationships.evidence_quote: L-arginine (nitric oxide donor) was able to enhance orofacial pain by upregulating CGRP expressions in vivo

relationships.subject: Olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraganglionic administration of CGRP and olcegepant exacerbated and alleviated orofacial pain, respectively

relationships.subject: Cilnidipine
relationships.evidence_quote: L-arginine upregulated the expression of CGRP, and this effect was diminished by cilnidipine (N-type calcium channel blocker) while not by mibefradil (L-type calcium channel blocker)

key_findings: CGRP drives a positive-feedback neuron-glia loop: CGRP raises iNOS/NO via p38 in SGCs, and NO raises CGRP via N-type calcium channels in neurons
CGRP knockdown or olcegepant alleviates orofacial pain
